definition: Introjection is a historical term used by Avenarius for a theory about knowledge that treats consciousness as located inside the organism and treats what we know of the outer world as inner images or copies. In this usage, it also names the developmental tendency to think that other beings act from such inner representations and then to apply the same idea to oneself.
